Live after that boot: uid 0, 24/24 listed units masked-runtime and none active (18 inactive + 6 failed), zero processes under the 24 listed binaries, newhome-fix active, all 20 app_disable rows true, both sentinels present, the same v42 artifact on the TV. First v42 run (same day, before the batched-stop fix) exposed the sequential-stop bug: stopped=2 fail=22 after a 45 s deadline while 16 binaries were still alive; v42.1 queues one `systemctl --no-block stop` and confirms from the list-units dump. Earlier v41: cold boots 36 s (attempt 1 fast-exit t=29, attempt 2 direct-parent t=36) and 49 s (AUL late); kill -9 recovery ~2 s; uninstall/recover cycle verified 2026-10-27; stock IL f61f60dd.. intact, payload_backup.dll = v41. **OTA stack pinned 2026-10-30 14:50** (app restart, no reboot): the lists went 24->34 units / 24->26 binaries (vdsystem-update-manager.{service,timer}, was-background-update.{service,path}, swu-verifier-tv.{service,timer}, swu-core-tv.service, swu-service.service, vdca-update.service, swu-auto-upgrade.timer); v42 re-ran within 2 s and beaconed `masks=34 stopped=34 killed=1 fail=0 missing=0 activating=0 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok newhome=set(0),loop-active`, all ten new units masked-runtime and none active, zero processes under the two new binaries. The global activating count fell 2 -> 0 because vdsystem-update-manager.service was a SECOND restart loop (Restart=always, ExecMainStatus=0) - the same class as easysetup. Rejected lever: the vendor OTA switch ConditionPathExists=!/mnt/backup/OS_UPGRADE_FLAG, because /mnt/backup -> /mnt/systemrw (trap 9). **Batch 3 (2026-10-30): 22 voice ids applied, the 16 sharing ids REVERTED.** Owner: no voice, SmartThings used. The first attempt also disabled the sharing area (38 ids, rows 20 -> 58) - and **SmartThings phone control stopped working**. **Cause of the SmartThings break, phone-confirmed the same evening: `org.tizen.easysetup-daemon`.** Voice 22 + tier 1 10 stayed online; disabling this one app flipped the phone offline. Re-enabled and launched; owner confirmed the phone online again (~18:51). It is denylisted, dropped from tier 2a, and its unit is off the mask list (masking the unit stops the same daemon). `samsung-analytics` stays denylisted too (the client requests its privilege) but re-enabling it did not restore the phone. Standing disable set: **37 app rows** (tier 1 10 + tier 2a 5 + voice 22) and **29 units / 23 binaries**. The standing set was then APPLIED live 2026-10-30 18:56 (app restart, v42): masks=29 stopped=29 killed=4 fail=0 missing=0 activating=0 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok, 37 app rows true, easysetup-daemon row false with its unit active and unmasked, analytics false, and the SmartThings stack alive. Owner confirmed the phone **online** right after that apply, so the standing set is the accepted state; **First 29-unit / 37-row cold boot PASSED 2026-10-30 19:29:41** (mains cycle): rooted direct-patch t=49 s, masks begin n=29, then masks=29 stopped=29 killed=4 fail=0 missing=0 activating=1 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok newhome=set(0),loop-started at t=54 s. Live after it: uid 0, 37 app rows, 29 masks, org.tizen.easysetup-daemon row false with its unit ACTIVE and NRestarts=0 (no loop), analytics false, the SmartThings stack alive, activating=0. **Phone confirmed online after that boot too** (owner, ~19:44). Investigation: docs/SMARTTHINGS-OFFLINE-2026-10-30.md. **v43 (payload hardening, 2026-10-30):** the landmark comm tags are now per-run (`PHYSRPT`+hex(pid) for the payload, `PHYRFORK`+hex(child pid) written post-fork into a pre-pinned buffer with raw writes only), the hunt prefers an exact tag match, then the task's `pid`/`tgid` words (`O_PID 0x2E8`, `O_TGID 0x2EC`, same DWARF fingerprint as cred/comm), and **refuses** a task whose pid is readable but different - the stale-landmark family; only an unreadable pid falls back to the old parent-uid rule. A cred is patched only when `cred == real_cred` (`SameCredPair`), closing the independent-patch path that could write a pair whose halves disagreed. `tools/sim_rpc.py` mirrors both rules and has three v43 tests; `tools/test_constants.py` locks the offsets and the three behaviours. **v43 deployed and boot-verified 2026-10-30**: deploy.sh installed 41,472 B (md5 `85cd0120`) at 20:07 with a fresh beacon token; the app did not come back for ~15 minutes (AUL relaunch delay, not a crash - it ran fine at 20:23), and the 21:25:55 cold boot rooted `self-patch` at t=56 s with `masks=29 stopped=29 killed=4 fail=0 missing=0 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok`. The on-TV marker shows the new path working: attempt 1 `child=c798a280 ... pu=unread tag=exact stale=0` (exact per-run tag - the case where the old code could only fall back to `maybe`), attempt 2 `child=dc069700 ... pu=5001 tag=exact`, then `self cred=real` and self-patch. Live: uid 0, 37 rows, 29 masks, md5 `85cd0120` on the TV. **v44 deployed + cold-boot verified 2026-11-01**: deploy over 31337 (SIZE=41472, md5 `7fce4683`, PREV_IL=`85cd0120` = the v43 rollback copy, TOKEN_FILE rotated, MASKFILE 29 units / 23 binaries, COPY=ok, DEPLOY_DONE). Mains-cycle boot 14:23:02: attempts 1-2 `tag=exact` but a high parent -> `high-alloc ... fast-exit`; attempt 3 `child=d1ce9140 ... pu=5001 tag=exact stale=0`, `self cred == real`, self-patch uid=0 at t=38 s, `ROOTCHAN` t=38, `masks=29 stopped=29 killed=5 fail=0 missing=0 listed-activating=0 loop-check=ok newhome=set(0),loop-started` at t=45. Live: uid 0, CapEff=0x3fffffffff, 29 masks, md5 `7fce4683` on the TV. (The deploy-restart before the boot hit the attempt-1 stale window and did not root; the cold boot re-rolled it - see CHANGELOG.md.)
